$schema: Kenney "Particle Pack" (CC0), hand-picked, downscaled and re-encoded. See LICENSE.txt and docs/decisions.md D-047.
format: PNG, 256x256, grey+alpha (colour type 4). White luminance only — src/lib/vfx.ts tints each sprite at draw time.
status: In use. src/lib/domain/vfx-scenes.ts names the texture for every effect; src/lib/vfx.ts loads and draws it.

files.hint: a ringed circle with nodes on its circumference — a summoning circle read edge-on
a vertical crackling bolt — electric detail, high rarity only
a filled centre throwing many rays — a single-frame flash of impact
a horizontal anamorphic lens flare — a wide light bar
a thin four-point glint, almost all highlight — the cheapest twinkle
a filled disc with a bright rim — a body of light, not an outline
a soft four-point sparkle with a wide falloff — the default drifting light
concentric rings — one texture that already reads as a repeating pulse
a thin soft-edged ring — an expanding shockwave
a solid five-pointed star — a small crisp emblem, no glow of its own
a bright hard-edged four-point star — the main celebratory particle
a pair of crescent arcs — a swoosh that reads as rotation
a vertical tapered streak — a mote in motion
